title: The repository binding had no remote URL, which the workspace prepare takes from it and the SCM port cannot resolve from the opaque repository identifier
resolution: RemoteUrl, HTTPS without user information, is required in the binding input and output; design decision 11 and contract page section 4; tests failed before

title: BranchName allowed only printable ASCII up to 255 characters, so it refused valid Git branch names such as a Cyrillic release branch
resolution: BranchName follows git check-ref-format --branch, compared against Git 2.43; the 1024 bound is justified in its description and decision 11; a test failed before

title: The spec and contract page offered the operator bearer on every mutation but the receiver, although logIn and logOut accept only the cookie with CSRF
resolution: The requirement, its scenario, and contract page section 2 exclude logIn and logOut from the bearer; a test pins which mutations declare it

title: Authentication before reading the body was required of every operation, which the webhook receiver cannot meet because its signature covers the raw body
resolution: The order is limited to session and bearer operations; the receiver reads bounded raw bytes, then verifies, then parses, in the spec and contract page sections 2 and 5

title: Every project update was said to be compare-and-set, though member assignment and removal and the first binding carry no expected revision
resolution: The spec names the compare-and-set operations and the exceptions, with a scenario for concurrent assignments; contract page section 4 lists all of them

title: The 100-item paging rule covered every list, contradicting the unpaged listWorkers snapshot of design decision 17
resolution: The requirement, its scenario, and contract page section 6 exclude listWorkers; a test checks that every other list takes after

title: The cookie scheme description implied that the __Host- prefix also enforces HttpOnly and SameSite
resolution: The description now says the prefix enforces Secure, Path=/, and no Domain, and the server alone sets HttpOnly and SameSite, as design decision 4 does

title: Design decision 19 omitted that a login name starts with a letter or digit, as the LoginName schema requires
The record credited the coordinator with authorizing elevated review effort, which governance Routed effort leaves to an owner-approved governance change
resolution: The limitation now says the elevated efforts wait for that governance change and the authorized efforts stay: A medium, B high
